⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Materialized seek index for an audio source.

Each row stores one batch of entries. The `media_time`, `decode_time`, and
`trim_samples` arrays are parallel arrays. A playback runtime resolves a
requested media time by choosing the nearest preceding `decode_time`,
decoding forward, then trimming `trim_samples` samples from the decoded PCM.

## Fields
### Required
* `media_time`: [`AudioTimestamp`](../components/audio_timestamp.md)
* `decode_time`: [`AudioTimestamp`](../components/audio_timestamp.md)
* `trim_samples`: [`AudioDurationSamples`](../components/audio_duration_samples.md)

### Recommended

* `discontinuity`: [`AudioDiscontinuity`](../components/audio_discontinuity.md)

### Optional

* `audio_reference`: [`EntityPath`](../components/entity_path.md)
* `stream_id`: [`AudioStreamId`](../components/audio_stream_id.md)
